newsitem.title: USA: American Filtrona in acquisition talks.
newsitem.headline: American Filtrona in acquisition talks.

text.p: American Filtrona Corp said on Thursday it is engaged in negotiations for WBT Holdings LLC to acquire the company for $43.00 a share.

WBT Holdings is a limited liability company owned by several trusts for the benefit of members of the family of the late Walter Bunzl, a 28 percent shareholder of the company who left his stock in family trusts, American Filtrona said.

American Filtrona also said that it had been advised that beneficiaries of some of the trusts associated with family members of former chairman R. H. Bunzl, who was Walter Bunzl's brother, filed a complaint to remove a co-trustee of the trusts.

The suit alleges that the trustee's concurrent service as co-trustee for the Walter Bunzl trusts as well as the R. H. Bunzl trusts represents a conflict of interests with respect to the transaction under negotiation, American Filtrona said.
American Filtrona said is not able to assess the effect, if any, that such litigation may have upon the likelihood of completion or timing of the proposed sale.
Execution of a definitive acquisition agreement is subject to final negotiation of terms and conditions and completion of business and financial reviews, the company said.
Consummation of any transaction would be subject to normal regulatory filings, shareholder approvals and certain other conditions, American Filtrona said.
